name: Pull Request Quality Review
description: A lightweight PR review workflow: run tests, lint, security checks, summarise changes, and generate reviewer checklist.

steps.title: Run test suite
steps.description: Execute repository tests locally (pytest/unittest) to verify no regressions.

steps.title: Run linter / static checks
steps.description: Run linters and style checks relevant to repository (flake8, eslint, etc).

steps.title: Run sanitizer
steps.description: Run scripts/sanitize.py to detect obvious secret patterns.

steps.title: Generate PR summary
steps.description: Summarize changed files, highlight risky areas, and produce a checklist for reviewers.

steps.title: Assign reviewers & tags
steps.description: Suggest reviewers and necessary tags/labels (security, changelog, release-note).
